Use this page as the front door to the course. Open a published lesson and its class materials, or scan the planned modules to see where the sequence is going.

::: {.callout-important title="This week: November 16 to 20"}

1. **Monday, Lab 225:** Learn capacitor types, polarity, ratings, charge, and one complete $Q=CV$ example using [Capacitors from Zero](electronics-library/components/capacitors.qmd) and the [teaching slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1QKVYTvEYKO5p1Tl6bNlBuRuYwMWiad3VUAgJcsY9Dbg/edit){target="_blank"}. In the [beginner notebook](https://jupyter.org/try-jupyter/lab/index.html?fromURL=https%3A%2F%2Fandrewandrade.ca%2Ftech-edu-resources%2Fassets%2Ftej-computational%2Fnotebooks%2F10-capacitors-from-zero.ipynb){target="_blank"}, complete only Parts 1 and 2. The energy and part-choice sections are optional.
2. **Tuesday, Portable 1, regular teacher away:** Complete the [two-page capacitor worksheet](../assets/electronics/worksheets/capacitors-tuesday-worksheet.pdf). Everything needed is printed on the pages. No new lesson, hardware, Tinkercad, or notebook work is required. Upload clear photos of both pages.
3. **Wednesday, Lab 225:** Use [RC Charging and Discharging](electronics-library/components/rc-charge-discharge.qmd) and slides 1 to 10 of the [RC deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/130ilpoHB15CGT1_IQQuquD8zWLzIYprLojiKbAYDfk4/edit){target="_blank"}. Run the supplied [graph notebook](https://jupyter.org/try-jupyter/lab/index.html?fromURL=https%3A%2F%2Fandrewandrade.ca%2Ftech-edu-resources%2Fassets%2Ftej-computational%2Fnotebooks%2F11-rc-charge-discharge.ipynb){target="_blank"}, change one value, and compare the curves. Students run the provided NumPy code; they are not expected to write the exponential model.
4. **Thursday, Portable 1:** Complete Questions 1 to 4 of the [RC timing worksheet](../assets/electronics/worksheets/rc-timing-thursday-worksheet.pdf). Questions 5 and 6 are optional challenges. Use the [5 V RC station](circuits/hands-on-circuit-stations.qmd) for a teacher demonstration if it is ready.
5. **Friday, Lab 220, half-day schedule:** Sort and identify the real resistors and capacitors, then rotate through the [hands-on circuit stations](circuits/hands-on-circuit-stations.qmd). Save one piece of measurement evidence and finish incomplete work. The RC design deck, third notebook, calculus bridge, and full Tinkercad design move to the following week.

[Open the complete capacitor week page](electronics-library/components/capacitors.qmd).

[Open the hands-on station build guide](circuits/hands-on-circuit-stations.qmd).

:::
